title: [Routine Help] Moisturizer recommendation with Erythromycin?
text:
I've started using Erythromycin topical gel 2% (switched from another topical because this is safe to treat acne during pregnancy) and have tried four different moisturizers but can’t seem to find one that doesn’t react with the Erythromycin to form a goopy, stringy, whitecast mess when I apply it. "Pilling" doesn't seem to describe it adequately. It's a hot mess. 

So far I have tried: TO Natural Moisturizing Factors, Acure Seriously Soothing Cloud Cream, Alba Botanica Hydration Sensation Gel Cream, and Derma-E Hydrating Night Cream. They all have this reaction when applied after the Erythro. 

Any recs from folks who use Erythromycin topical?

title: [Product question] Alternative to Acure Cloud Cream?
text:
I've used Acure's Seriously Soothing Cloud Cream for a couple years as part of my routine but the last time I bought it (a few months ago now) it seems like they've changed the formula - it has a strong smell and I just don't find it as effective. I'm bummed and wondering if there's something similar out there anyone could recommend (cruelty-free, unscented, hyaluronic acid + argan/rose/something similar oil combo)

Thanks!
